def: an elevation or leprous scab; figuratively, elation or cheerfulness; exaltation in rank or character
kjv: be accepted, dignity, excellency, highness, raise up self, rising.

words.word: him and behold if the rising
upon it and behold if the rising
to me and by reason of his highness

occurrences.text: If thou doest well, shalt thou not be accepted? and if thou doest not well, sin lieth at the door. And unto thee shall be his desire, and thou shalt rule over him.
Reuben, thou art my firstborn, my might, and the beginning of my strength, the excellency of dignity, and the excellency of power:

When a man shall have in the skin of his flesh a rising, a scab, or bright spot, and it be in the skin of his flesh like the plague of leprosy; then he shall be brought unto Aaron the priest, or unto one of his sons the priests:
And the priest shall see him: and, behold, if the rising be white in the skin, and it have turned the hair white, and there be quick raw flesh in the rising;
words: him and behold if the rising

occurrences.text: And in the place of the boil there be a white rising, or a bright spot, white, and somewhat reddish, and it be shewed to the priest;

And if the bright spot stay in his place, and spread not in the skin, but it be somewhat dark; it is a rising of the burning, and the priest shall pronounce him clean: for it is an inflammation of the burning.
Then the priest shall look upon it: and, behold, if the rising of the sore be white reddish in his bald head, or in his bald forehead, as the leprosy appeareth in the skin of the flesh;
words: upon it and behold if the rising

occurrences.text: And for a rising, and for a scab, and for a bright spot:
Shall not his excellency make you afraid? and his dread fall upon you?
For destruction from God was a terror to me, and by reason of his highness I could not endure.
words: to me and by reason of his highness

occurrences.text: When he raiseth up himself, the mighty are afraid: by reason of breakings they purify themselves.
They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
They are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves.
